name: Terri Jones
prior_offices: Albany County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Terri Jones is an Albany County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Laramie Reporter wrote that Albany County re-elected both Republican and Democratic county commissioners. She won the November 2022 general election.
